moat.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 本公司在汽車抬頭顯示器市場營運，該市場競爭激烈且技術發展迅速。儘管公司在研發方面投入，並提供多種解決方案，但目前缺乏強大的經濟護城河。品牌影響力有限，專利保護的競爭優勢不明顯，客戶轉換成本不高，且未見網路效應。公司尚未實現持續盈利，資本配置記錄尚短，且面臨技術和市場需求變化的挑戰。這些評分是基於現有公開資訊的定性判斷，並非財務測量。
moat.overall_moat_verdict_en: Operating in a competitive and rapidly evolving automotive head-up display market, the company currently lacks strong economic moats. Despite investments in research and development and offering diverse solutions, brand power is limited, the competitive advantage from patent protection is unclear, customer switching costs are not high, and network effects are absent. The company has not achieved sustained profitability, its capital allocation track record is brief, and it faces challenges from technological and market demand shifts. These scores represent qualitative judgments based on available public information, not financial measurements.

stock.description: Jiangsu New Vision Automotive Electronics, Co., Ltd engages in the research and development of head-up display solutions in China. The company's products include CyberLens, its windshield HUD (W-HUD) solution that uses windshield projection technology to display basic driving information, such asspeed, navigation directions, driving assistance alerts and media information; and CyberVision, its augmented reality HUD (AR-HUD) solution that uses algorithms and optical imaging to overlay virtual information. The company sells its products to original equipment manufacturing customers. Its solutions including optical design solutions, such as design and testing of optical imaging systems and lighting solutions, stray light analysis and visualization, optical standards and custom tool development, 2D/3D display visualization and simulation; hardware solutions, such as circuit design and simulation, PCB design and performance analysis, mechanical design and engineering simulation, integrated optical-mechanical system design, standardized structural design database; verification and validation solutions, such as testing of optical imaging performance, testing of mechanical and environmental stress, testing of electrical and EMC compliance; software validation; hardware-in-the-loop, and real-world vehicle testing; software algorithm solutions, such as embedded software development, image processing algorithms, driving scenario simulation & HMI design, development of ASPICE-Compliant Process, functional safety and cybersecurity. Additionally, the company offers full-stack proprietary technology architecture that integrates hardware and software capabilities across optical design, mechanical engineering, electronics design, software algorithms and human-machine interface (HMI), as well as rigorous verification and validation processes. Jiangsu New Vision Automotive Electronics, Co., Ltd was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Yizheng, China.

stock.description_zh: 江蘇新視界汽車電子有限公司在中國從事抬頭顯示解決方案的研發。該公司的產品包括CyberLens，其擋風玻璃抬頭顯示器（W-HUD）解決方案，利用擋風玻璃投影技術顯示基本駕駛資訊，例如速度、導航方向、駕駛輔助警報和媒體資訊；以及CyberVision，其增強現實抬頭顯示器（AR-HUD）解決方案，利用演算法和光學成像疊加虛擬資訊。該公司向原始設備製造商客戶銷售其產品。其解決方案包括光學設計解決方案，例如光學成像系統和照明解決方案的設計和測試、雜散光分析和視覺化、光學標準和客製化工具開發、二維/三維顯示視覺化和模擬；硬體解決方案，例如電路設計和模擬、印刷電路板設計和性能分析、機械設計和工程模擬、整合光學機械系統設計、標準化結構設計資料庫；驗證和確認解決方案，例如光學成像性能測試、機械和環境應力測試、電氣和電磁相容性測試；軟體驗證；硬體在環測試和實際車輛測試；軟體演算法解決方案，例如嵌入式軟體開發、圖像處理演算法、駕駛場景模擬和人機介面設計、符合ASPICE標準的流程開發、功能安全和網路安全。此外，該公司提供整合光學設計、機械工程、電子設計、軟體演算法和人機介面硬體和軟體能力的全面專有技術架構，以及嚴格的驗證和確認流程。江蘇新視界汽車電子有限公司於二零一五年成立，總部位於中國揚州。
